InfoText:
Pick a theme, tick targets, hit Apply.

The preview is a real Win95 bevel,
not a screenshot.

Apply runs the same install.ps1 the
terminal does - no second code path.
NothingToDo: Nothing to do -- all recorded targets are up to date.
NothingToDoEmpty: Nothing to do -- the manifest is empty (no targets have been installed).
LogonTaskNotRegistered: Logon task not found -- nothing to remove.
NotInstalled: not installed on this machine - skipped.
RepaintNote: Repainting an already-themed app works while it is running; a first install does not.
BuildStale: desktop/out is out of date with themes/*.json. Run 'node tools/build-desktop.js' first, or pass -Force to install what is already built.
BuildStaleForce: WARNING: installing a build that is out of date with themes/*.json (-Force).
NodeNotFoundBuild: node not found - cannot verify the build is current. Installing what is in desktop/out as-is.
SkippedByTargets: WARNING: -Target all would skip {0} - they are selectable but in no dispatch list.
HelpOneApp: .\install.ps1 -Target freebuff -Palette klite     one app, one palette
StatusHint: Pick a theme, tick the targets, press APPLY. Editing any colour forks it into Custom.
BdGoodEmojiDesc:
GoodEmoji v1.0.0 (Wintage)

Replaces crying, sad, and toxic emojis with joyful and funny ones:
  - sob -> joy
  - cry -> smile
  - pleading -> sunglasses
  - skull -> slight_smile
  - wilted_rose -> rose
  - clown -> thumbsup
  - sad/frown -> smiley/grin
  - broken_heart -> heart
  - middle_finger -> peace

Dynamically monitors messages, reactions, and Twemoji assets via MutationObserver.
BdRemoveStickersDesc:
RemoveStickers v1.0.0 (Wintage)

Completely disables and removes stickers in Discord:
  - Hides sticker renderings in chat messages
  - Hides the sticker picker button from the input bar
  - Hides stickers from autocomplete suggestions
  - Automatically collapses empty sticker-only message rows

Uses zero-latency CSS injection via BdApi.DOM.addStyle and an active DOM cleaner.
